fighters.name: Jaxon “Iron” Reed
fighters.bio: A Houston native who turned pro in 2019, Reed built his reputation on a suffocating pressure style and has stopped 20 of his 24 opponents inside the distance. He headlines Thunder in Paradise this October in a career-defining heavyweight title clash.

fighters.name: Marcus “The Viper” Vane
fighters.bio: Known for fight-ending combinations delivered in flurries, Vane avenged an early setback with a twelve-round decision win over Leon Silva in February — and now heads into a rematch as the man to beat at 160.

fighters.name: Elias “Ghost” Stone
fighters.bio: A veteran of the division with the most fights on the roster, Stone earned his nickname for a defensive style that makes him nearly impossible to find clean. He meets Jaxon Reed for the heavyweight title in October.

fighters.name: Damian “Ruthless” Cross
fighters.bio: Undefeated through fifteen professional bouts, Cross scored a third-round knockout over Ray Dixon in his hometown debut and returns to face him again this December in a highly anticipated rematch.

fighters.name: Leon “The King” Silva
fighters.bio: A former title challenger with over a decade of experience, Silva is looking to reclaim his standing at 160 after a razor-close decision loss to Marcus Vane earlier this year.

fighters.name: Victor “Savage” Kane
fighters.bio: One of the promotion's hardest hitters pound-for-pound, Kane's only loss came against a former champion. He's currently rebuilding toward a title shot at lightweight.

fighters.name: Tyler “Titan” Bradley
fighters.bio: The roster's fastest-rising prospect, Bradley turned heads with a seventh-round stoppage of Victor Kane at Night of Champions and remains undefeated as he climbs the heavyweight rankings.

fighters.name: Ray “Bullet” Dixon
fighters.bio: A come-forward brawler known for his work rate, Dixon is looking to settle the score with Damian Cross in their December rematch after a knockout loss in their first meeting.
